snippet.title: هل تستطيع حل ألغاز الملك دون التحدث؟ 🤫 #قصص #تحدي #shorts
snippet.description:
حكم الملك بإعدام والدها ظلماً، لكنها هزمت جبروته بصمتها. اكتشف كيف أنقذت هذه الفتاة أباها من خلال حكمة وذكاء لا يصدقان.

تتناول هذه القصة رحلة راعٍ بسيط رفض دفع ضريبة جائرة، ليجد نفسه في مواجهة مباشرة مع الملك. تدخلت ابنته رحاب لتكون صوت الحق، حيث واجهت الملك بسلسلة من الألغاز الصعبة لإثبات براءته. إنها واحدة من أجمل حكايات السفير التي تبرز كيف يمكن لقوة العقل أن تنتصر على بطش السلطة في اللحظات الحاسمة.

تعد هذه القصة من بين أفضل قصص قصيرة تحمل دروساً في سرعة البديهة والعدل، وتذكرنا بأن الحكمة هي السلاح الأقوى في مواجهة الظلم. نتابع كيف قاد ذكاء الابنة الملك إلى حل الألغاز، مما أدى في النهاية إلى نجاة والدها من حكم الإعدام.

اشترك في القناة ليصلك كل يوم حكاية جديدة وعبرة لا تُنسى. برأيك، ما هو اللغز الذي كنت ستطرحه على الملك لو كنت مكان رحاب؟

snippet.title: Three beautiful bottles...#riverfinds #mudlarking #treasurehunting
snippet.description:
I almost floated home after spotting the wonderful early ointment in heavy flint glass, with wonderful flared lip and huge rough old pontil scar on the base. I cannot find a parallel for it in glass, early ointments were more commonly produced in tin-glazed earthenwares, the biscuity remains of which do turn up in the river gravels from time to time.

A pontil scar on the base shows how the bottle was made and with bottle making techniques evolving through time, this feature generally indicates a pre-1860 vessel, certainly in British utility glass. Once the bottle had been blown and shaped, the glassmaker attached an iron rod (the pontil) to its base, to hold it securely while the neck and rim were finished. This was then snapped off, leaving a distinctive scar in the glass. The technique gradually fell out of general use as improved manufacturing methods with alternative holding devices replaced the pontil and the streamlined the bottle-making process.

The penny perfume is another favourite bottle find for me this year. Not as well known perhaps, and certainly not as plentiful as the penny inks, these delicate Victorian scent bottles were produced in an array of shapes and colours and it's a rare treat to find a new one.

Ömür Mete'ye kızdı. ANNELİĞİMİ KULLANDIN

Ömür Usta 9. Bölüm sahnelerini izlemek için tıklayın👉🏻 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLczBQpQ6gc5g

Bölüm Özeti

Büyük ikramiyenin Ömür’e çıkması tüm mahallede bayram havası estirir. Ancak Mete’yle yaşadığı sert yüzleşme evdeki sevince gölge düşürür ve Ömür oğluyla ilgili net bir karar verir. Paranın ailesini birbirine düşürmesinden korkan Ömür’ün tutumu, yeni bir hayat için kendisini sıkıştıran çocuklarıyla arasında gerginliğe yol açar. 

İkramiye haberinin yayılmasıyla birlikte çevredekilerin aileye yaklaşımı bir anda değişirken, Koray da yeniden Nazlı’nın karşısına çıkar. 

Diğer yandan Vildan’ın mahalleye dönüş zamanlamasını sorgulayan Cüneyt’in içine şüphe düşer. Gece vakti sokakta Vildan ve Aliş’in önünü kesen yabancılar ise tüm aileye korku dolu anlar yaşatır. 

Boşanmayı reddeden Nevra hem Tunç’a hem de Ömür’e karşı öfkesini daha tehlikeli bir boyuta taşır. Restoranda yaşanan kriz Tunç’u zor durumda bırakırken, Nevra’nın sözleriyle kafası karışan İpek gerçeğin peşine düşer. 

Dışarıdaki tehditler ve evdeki beklentiler arasında kalan Ömür’ü, ailesini bir arada tutmak için zorlu bir sınav beklemektedir.

Dizi Özeti

Aile bağları, ihanet, aşk, sınıf çatışmaları ve ikinci şanslar üzerine kurulan “Ömür Usta”; tüm yaralarına rağmen hayata tutunmayı başaran bir kadının, kendi ışığını yeniden keşfetme hikayesini anlatacak.

Oyuncular: Nurgül Yeşilçay, Bülent İnal, Gonca Vuslateri, Enes Koçak, İbrahim Selim, Gülçin Kültür Şahin, Pınar Çağlar Gençtürk, Sude Zülal Güler ve Zerrin Sümer

snippet.title: J’ai fait des Pommes de terre Farcies façon hachis Parmentier 🔥
snippet.description:
Pommes de terre farcies façon hachis Parmentier 🔥

Ingrédients :
-4 pommes de terre
-4 saucisses
-1 échalote 
-150g de coulis de tomates
-1 CàS de beurre
-120g de mozzarella râpée
-sel et poivre

1. 50 à 60 mn à 200 degrés pour les pommes de terre.
2. On fait revenir la chair à saucisse avec l’échalote, on déglace avec un peu d’eau et on ajoute le coulis de tomates. On laisse réduire 5 mn.
3. On mélange la chaire des pommes de terre avec le beurre et la mozzarella.
4. On dispose la viande puis la pomme de terre et on enfourne avec un peu de fromage par-dessus pour gratiner environ 10 à 15 mn.

snippet.title: How You'd Run A Bullet Train Through A Moving Desert
snippet.description:
Imagine you're on a bullet train doing 300 km an hour, and up ahead, the desert is moving. On Saudi Arabia's Haramain railway, between Mecca and Medina, sand was enemy number one. So how do you keep a desert off the rails?

In this video:
🐢 The problem: in 2017 testing, trains had to slow to as little as 5 km/h where sand piled up between the rails
🧹 Why clearing isn't enough: the wind keeps bringing more, and sand clogs the stone ballast under the track
🌬️ The real villains: gusts of up to 100 km/h, and heat past 50 °C (51.8 °C at Mecca's Grand Mosque in June 2024)
🕳️ The trench and the "draa": a wide ditch on the windward side, with an earth ridge, catches sand like a doormat
🚜 The unglamorous part: digging the trenches out, again and again
💨 The blowers: mounted close to the wheels to clear sand off the rails
🦆 The "Pato" nose: shaped like a duck's bill to cut air noise, not to stop sand
🛡️ The sealed train: higher air pressure inside, reinforced door seals, military-grade filters, and a screen-guard film on the driver's windows

Every part is real. The Haramain High Speed Railway links Mecca, Jeddah and Medina over about 450 km, and it opened to passengers in 2018. An engineering study by Spain's INECO found that about 197 km of the line could face wind-blown sand, and trench-and-ridge sand traps were built in places along it. The trains are Spanish Talgo 350s, given a "desert pack" of more than 30 changes for sand and heat.

What would you fight first: the sand or the heat?

snippet.title: Tesla Reality View is GTA 6 in real life (no game engine)
snippet.description:
Tesla Reality View in FSD (Supervised) v15 is basically GTA 6 in real life, except the camera doesn't follow you out of the car :-)

Two days after Rockstar ships the pinnacle of rendering triangles, Tesla launches a real-time generative driving visualization from a virtual camera above the car.

Elon says it uses no game engine and consumes the same vision features the car drives on. 

He says a ~1B parameter diffusion model takes the last view it drew, adds noise, and denoises it in real time on half of one AI4 TRIP processor.
